description: Practical growth workflows for home service businesses, starting with a lead-to-job revenue leak audit.

interface.shortDescription: Find gaps from leads to jobs
interface.longDescription: Three practical skills for home service contractors: Revenue Leak Audit, Missed Call Revenue Calculator and Unsold Estimate Audit. Each delivers a company-branded Markdown report and styled HTML companion using verified website fonts/colors or owner-defined trade palettes. Diagnose causes, preserve evidence and assumption labels, and build an internally usable implementation blueprint. Conditional revenue is not guaranteed. No live CRM, phone, advertising, scheduling, automatic outreach or monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Audit where leads fall through the cracks in my home service business.
Help estimate missed-call opportunity and practical fixes.
Our estimates go out but no one owns follow-up. Audit the process.
